remaining.name: rls_policy_always_true
remaining.title: RLS Policy Always True
remaining.description: Detects RLS policies that use overly permissive expressions like `USING (true)` or `WITH CHECK (true)` for UPDATE, DELETE, or INSERT operations. SELECT policies with `USING (true)` are intentionally excluded as this pattern is often used deliberately for public read access.
remaining.detail: Table `public.email_suppressions` has an RLS policy `platform_wide` for `ALL` that allows unrestricted access (both USING and WITH CHECK are always true). This effectively bypasses row-level security for -.
